input.summary: Add a 90-day software / 30-day services warranty with repair, replacement or refund, and carve it out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently supplied "AS IS" with all express and implied warranties disclaimed, which is walk-away territory for us, so we have added our fallback warranty (90 days software conformance to Documentation, 30 days services) with repair, replacement or refund, and carved those express warranties out of the disclaimer so it does not swallow them.
